typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		record_id as integer,
		target_object_name as string,
		data_classification as string,
		business_effective_date as timestamp,
		target_application as string,
		count_type as string,
		count as integer,
		Data_source as string,
		processing_date as timestamp,
		running_count as integer,
		todsh_run_id as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		record_id as integer,
		target_object_name as string,
		data_classification as string,
		business_effective_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		target_application as string,
		count_type as string,
		count as integer,
		Data_source as string,
		processing_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		running_count as integer,
		todsh_run_id as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		record_id,
		target_object_name,
		data_classification,
		business_effective_date,
		target_application,
		count_type,
		count,
		Data_source,
		processing_date,
		running_count,
		todsh_run_id),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
